title: PAR-134 AC1021 TABLE unretained CMC override semantic-completeness gate
mode: generated AC1021 DWG object-vector fast slice
scope: Prevent structurally consumed but unretained per-cell and table-level TABLE override values from being marked semantically complete
Continue parsing subsequent cells and table override sections after semantic completeness is lost, preserving stream alignment
Reject undocumented high bits in the bounded AC1021 TABLE cell/table override masks

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §20.4.96.1 identifies the AC1021 table-cell override mask, including CMC background/content/border color fields, and the table-level title/header/data row color and border masks. The current typed TABLE projection does not retain these individual values.

localCode.finding: The bounded parser consumed override fields but left semantic completeness true; typed TABLE output is conditioned on that flag, while incomplete snapshots retain the anonymous-block INSERT fallback.

productionSummary: Thread semantic-completeness state through AC1021 cell and table override parsing; any nonzero unretained override mask disqualifies typed TABLE output without aborting the structural parse.
Separate structural cell-parse success from semantic completeness so remaining cells and trailing override masks are still consumed after an override is found.
Reject mask bits above the ODA-documented AC1021 cell/table override ranges rather than silently ignoring potentially length-bearing fields.

generatedControls.wireAndParser: Locally authored AC1021 object frames encode a ByLayer CMC in a cell background-color override and a ByLayer CMC in a table title-row-color override. Both cases assert structural read success, semantic incompleteness, and cursor alignment at a following sentinel; existing no-override text/block controls remain semantically complete.
generatedControls.evidenceBoundary: The vectors use the ODA-documented common CMC representation and flag positions; they do not claim producer-authored AC1021 TABLE support or semantic retention of override colors.

evidenceLimits: CMC values are still parsed and discarded; this change only prevents the incomplete typed semantic path from claiming completeness and retains the existing anonymous-block fallback.
No independent producer, native CAD application, full suite, external semantic route, or platform qualification was used.
No persistent fixture, dependency, or support promotion was added.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
nextLocalItem: Continue the PAR-134 audit of TABLECONTENT cell-style/content-format CMC reads and DXF projections; where values remain intentionally skipped, carry semantic incompleteness through the TABLECONTENT path. Then resume exact-source PAR-03/PAR-04 associative-action classification.
